Lessons.Title: Tenths and Hundredths, Together
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goal: You will write equivalent fractions to add tenths and hundredths, up to a sum of 1.
Key idea: Tenths and hundredths describe the same whole using interchangeable partition units: a tenth is ten hundredths.
How to reason: Convert tenths to hundredths by multiplying numerator and denominator by ten, then combine.
Source-inspired opening: Warm-up: Notice and Wonder: Shaded Rectangles and Squares (10 minutes). Use the teacher-provided mathematical representations and explain how different valid answers arise.

Activity 1: Tenths and Hundredths (15 minutes): apply the learning goal to quantities such as \(\frac{1}{10}\), \(\frac{4}{10}\), \(\frac{6}{10}\), \(\frac{50}{100}\). First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.

Activity 2: Walk, Stop, and Sip (20 minutes): apply the learning goal to quantities such as \(\frac{2}{10}\), \(\frac{5}{100}\), \(\frac{5}{10} + \frac{1}{10}\), \(\frac{50}{100} + \frac{10}{100}\). First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.
Original source Cool-down is access-restricted/unverified; Edulytics substitutes goal-aligned independently authored teacher-reviewed exit prompt.
